label: Jibneh Arabieh
note: Of the Bedouin first; mild, less salty than feta; also the filling of knafeh

about.text: A soft white cheese of the Middle East, popular around the Persian Gulf, with a mild taste like feta but less salty; originally from Bedouin goat or sheep milk, now mostly cow milk.

how.text: Soft white table and cooking cheese found all over the Middle East, strongest in the Gulf.
